tools.name: partnerize_get_partner
tools.description: Get the partner (publisher) account details for a partner ID: name, status, contact and settings. Good first call to confirm which partner the login reaches. Partners API: GET /user/publisher/{publisher_id}.

tools.name: partnerize_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the campaigns this partner has on a status: a = approved, p = pending, r = rejected (default a). Use the campaign ids for the other campaign tools. Partners API: GET /user/publisher/{publisher_id}/campaign/{status}.

tools.name: partnerize_list_campaign_creatives
tools.description: List the banners, text links and other creatives on one campaign, with optional filters for active status, tags and creative type. Partners API: GET /user/publisher/{publisher_id}/campaign/{campaign_id}/creative.

tools.name: partnerize_list_campaign_vouchers
tools.description: List the voucher (promo) codes available on one campaign for this partner. Partners API: GET /user/publisher/{publisher_id}/campaign/{campaign_id}/voucher.

tools.name: partnerize_list_campaign_commissions
tools.description: List this partner's commission rates on one campaign (the campaign-level commission set). Partners API: GET /v2/campaigns/{campaignId}/publishers/{publisherId}/commissions/campaign.

tools.name: partnerize_list_brands
tools.description: List the brands (advertisers) and campaigns this partner can discover on the network. Partners API: GET /v2/publishers/{publisherId}/discovery/advertisers.

tools.name: partnerize_list_invitations
tools.description: List the campaign invitations this partner has received from brands (pending, accepted or declined). Partners API: GET /v2/publishers/{publisher_id}/invitations/advertisers/.

tools.name: partnerize_list_websites
tools.description: List the websites and apps this partner has registered on the network (the sites that tracking links may send traffic from). Partners API: GET /user/publisher/{publisher_id}/website.

tools.name: partnerize_list_feeds
tools.description: List the product feeds available to this partner. Partners API: GET /user/publisher/{publisher_id}/feed.

tools.name: partnerize_list_tracking_links
tools.description: List this partner's tracking links (campaign, destination URL, parameters and active state). Partners API: GET /v2/publishers/{publisher_id}/links.

tools.name: partnerize_get_tracking_link
tools.description: Get one tracking link by id, with its campaign, destination URL and parameters. Partners API: GET /v2/publishers/{publisher_id}/links/{link_id}.

tools.name: partnerize_get_payment_summary
tools.description: Summarise the value of this partner's conversions and payments (totals by status). Partners API: GET /user/publisher/{publisher_id}/payment/summary.

tools.name: partnerize_list_selfbills
tools.description: List this partner's self-billing invoices (the statements the network issues for payouts). Partners API: GET /user/publisher/{publisher_id}/selfbill.

tools.name: partnerize_get_conversions_report
tools.description: Get the partner's conversions report (JSON) for a date range, optionally filtered by status (approved, pending, rejected) and currency. Pages with offset. Partners API: GET /reporting/report_publisher/publisher/{publisher_id}/conversion.json.

tools.name: partnerize_create_tracking_link
tools.description: Create a tracking link for one campaign (a new link record; it does not change existing links). Partners API: POST /v2/publishers/{publisher_id}/links.

tools.name: partnerize_update_tracking_link
tools.description: Change one tracking link: its destination, description, parameters or active state. Only the fields you pass are sent. Partners API: PATCH /v2/publishers/{publisher_id}/links/{link_id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: partnerize_list_feeds, partnerize_list_tracking_links, partnerize_get_tracking_link, partnerize_list_selfbills · Private data: partnerize_get_partner, partnerize_create_tracking_link · Public sink: partnerize_list_websites, partnerize_create_tracking_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: partnerize_list_feeds, partnerize_list_tracking_links, partnerize_get_tracking_link, partnerize_list_selfbills · Private data: partnerize_get_partner, partnerize_create_tracking_link · Public sink: partnerize_list_websites, partnerize_create_tracking_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
